recipes.name: service-tests
recipes.purpose: Service end-to-end with batched inference, dedup across feeds, 409 and failure paths (needs only aiohttp and pytest).

recipes.name: batch-equivalence
recipes.command: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q serving/tests/test_batch.py; else python3 -m pytest -q serving/tests/test_batch.py || echo 'torch/transformers unavailable here'; fi
recipes.purpose: predict_batch on mixed-length headlines matches per-item predict (same direction, confidence within 1e-4) on a tiny random BERT.
